digest.component_or_area: Reconciler outbound comment ID recording invariant
propositions: Outbound Jira comment posts succeed but returned comment IDs are not recorded locally, leaving comment_ids count unchanged despite successful post operations
The invariant divergence (posts succeeded, local comment_ids gained none) must be debounced across 2 consecutive reconcile passes before firing a bridge alert, not on the first occurrence
The shared _record_comment_id seam must tally every successful post independent of whether local recording succeeds, capturing cases where the post tallies but entry lacks local_comment_key
Cross-pass debounce state persists in bridge_state/comment_id_divergence.json and must fail open to counter 0 when corrupt or absent without breaking the reconcile pass
A bridge alert appends to bridge_alerts JSONL with dedup key bridge-alert:comment-id-divergence, naming the invariant and pass_id when 2 consecutive divergent observations occur
